verdict.rationale: Yapily documents transaction categorisation with merchant detection and "spending insights", which is a thin form of automated insight over financial data. Nothing says these insights are AI-generated, that they include suggestions, or that they appear inside the product rather than as API output. The MCP/llms.txt items only connect coding agents to the documentation, not to user data, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: explicit AI-generated insights, actionable suggestions, an in-product insight surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.
